title: A Busy Journey to the Office

sentences.text_target: The alarm clock sounds early in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /ði əˈlɑːm klɒk saʊndz ˈɜːli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Le réveil sonne tôt le matin.

sentences.text_target: Mark wakes up in his warm bed.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk weɪks ʌp ɪn hɪz wɔːm bɛd/
sentences.text_native: Mark se réveille dans son lit chaud.

sentences.text_target: He gets up quickly because he has a lot of work today.
sentences.phonetic: /hi gɛts ʌp ˈkwɪkli bɪˈkɒz hi hæz ə lɒt ɒv wɜːk təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il se lève rapidement car il a beaucoup de travail aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He walks to the small kitchen.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks tuː ðə smɔːl ˈkɪtʃɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il se dirige vers la petite cuisine.

sentences.text_target: He makes a hot cup of coffee.
sentences.phonetic: /hi meɪks ə hɒt kʌp ɒv ˈkɒfi/
sentences.text_native: Il se prépare une tasse de café chaud.

sentences.text_target: He eats some simple toast with butter.
sentences.phonetic: /hi iːts sʌm ˈsɪmpl təʊst wɪð ˈbʌtə/
sentences.text_native: Il mange des toasts simples avec du beurre.

sentences.text_target: Then he puts on his heavy winter coat.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hi pʊts ɒn hɪz ˈhɛvi ˈwɪntə kəʊt/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il enfile son lourd manteau d'hiver.

sentences.text_target: He puts on his comfortable brown shoes.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts ɒn hɪz ˈkʌmfətəbl braʊn ʃuːz/
sentences.text_native: Il met ses chaussures marron confortables.

sentences.text_target: He leaves his home and closes the door.
sentences.phonetic: /hi liːvz hɪz həʊm ænd ˈkləʊzɪz ðə dɔː/
sentences.text_native: Il quitte son domicile et ferme la porte.

sentences.text_target: He locks the front door securely.
sentences.phonetic: /hi lɒks ðə frʌnt dɔː sɪˈkjʊəli/
sentences.text_native: Il verrouille soigneusement la porte d'entrée.

sentences.text_target: He walks fast down the wet street.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks fɑːst daʊn ðə wɛt striːt/
sentences.text_native: Il marche d'un pas vif dans la rue mouillée.

sentences.text_target: He reaches the corner near the busy bus stop.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈriːtʃɪz ðə ˈkɔːnə nɪə ðə ˈbɪzi bʌs stɒp/
sentences.text_native: Il arrive au coin de la rue, près de l'arrêt de bus très fréquenté.

sentences.text_target: Many people are waiting for public transport.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈpiːpl ɑː ˈweɪtɪŋ fɔː ˈpʌblɪk ˈtrænspɔːt/
sentences.text_native: Beaucoup de gens attendent les transports en commun.

sentences.text_target: He waits only a minute for the bus.
sentences.phonetic: /hi weɪts ˈəʊnli ə ˈmɪnɪt fɔː ðə bʌs/
sentences.text_native: Il n'attend qu'une minute le bus.

sentences.text_target: The large red bus arrives on time.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə lɑːdʒ rɛd bʌs əˈraɪvz ɒn taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Le grand bus rouge arrive à l'heure.

sentences.text_target: The driver opens the front doors.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪvə ˈəʊpənz ðə frʌnt dɔːz/
sentences.text_native: Le conducteur ouvre les portes avant.

sentences.text_target: Mark steps inside and pays with his contactless card.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk stɛps ˈɪnsaɪd ænd peɪz wɪð hɪz ˈkɒntæktlɪs kɑːd/
sentences.text_native: Mark monte à bord et paie avec sa carte sans contact.

sentences.text_target: The bus is very crowded this morning.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə bʌs ɪz ˈvɛri ˈkraʊdɪd ðɪs ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Le bus est très bondé ce matin.

sentences.text_target: There are no free seats left.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː nəʊ friː siːts lɛft/
sentences.text_native: Il ne reste aucun siège libre.

sentences.text_target: He stands near the window.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stændz nɪə ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
sentences.text_native: Il se tient debout près de la fenêtre.

sentences.text_target: He looks outside at the heavy traffic.
sentences.phonetic: /hi lʊks ˈaʊtsaɪd æt ðə ˈhɛvi ˈtræfɪk/
sentences.text_native: Il regarde dehors, observant la circulation dense.

sentences.text_target: Cars and bikes move slowly in the rain.
sentences.phonetic: /kɑːz ænd baɪks muːv ˈsləʊli ɪn ðə reɪn/
sentences.text_native: Les voitures et les vélos avancent lentement sous la pluie.

sentences.text_target: Raindrops fall against the cold glass.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈreɪndrɒps fɔːl əˈgɛnst ðə kəʊld glɑːs/
sentences.text_native: Des gouttes de pluie frappent la vitre froide.

sentences.text_target: He takes his smartphone out of his pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /hi teɪks hɪz ˈsmɑːtfəʊn aʊt ɒv hɪz ˈpɒkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il sort son smartphone de sa poche.

sentences.text_target: He reads a few important messages.
sentences.phonetic: /hi riːdz ə fjuː ɪmˈpɔːtənt ˈmɛsɪʤɪz/
sentences.text_native: Il lit quelques messages importants.

sentences.text_target: The bus turns right and crosses a long bridge.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə bʌs tɜːnz raɪt ænd ˈkrɒsɪz ə lɒŋ brɪʤ/
sentences.text_native: Le bus tourne à droite et traverse un long pont.

sentences.text_target: They cross the wide river safely.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ krɒs ðə waɪd ˈrɪvə ˈseɪfli/
sentences.text_native: Ils traversent la large rivière en toute sécurité.

sentences.text_target: Finally, the next stop is his destination.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, ðə nɛkst stɒp ɪz hɪz ˌdɛstɪˈneɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Enfin, l'arrêt suivant est sa destination.

sentences.text_target: He steps down onto the pavement.
sentences.phonetic: /hi stɛps daʊn ˈɒntuː ðə ˈpeɪvmənt/
sentences.text_native: Il descend sur le trottoir.

sentences.text_target: Mark walks to his office to start working at his desk.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk wɔːks tuː hɪz ˈɒfɪs tuː stɑːt ˈwɜːkɪŋ æt hɪz dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: Mark marche jusqu'à son bureau pour commencer à travailler.
